盯着每次/每天 token 烧多少，快超了提醒你并给省法。

skills.description: This skill should be used when converting a question bank such as Excel, CSV, or text into 考试酷 (examcoo.com) import-ready HTML, especially the copy-paste import format used in 考试酷 录入新试卷 editor. It documents the verified clipboard-import HTML structure for single choice, multiple choice, and judge questions, including the judge-answer encoding gotcha where 错 must be ASCII letter x with intAns 0 rather than 2 or the multiplication sign, so generated HTML imports with correct answers instead of showing 未选.

将 Excel / CSV 题库转换为考试酷（examcoo.com）可导入的 HTML，

  含位掩码答案编码、P 前缀规则、以及判断题错答案
  必须用 ASCII x + intAns=0 的已验证规范。
• examcoo 模式：{{C@}} 题库模板，支持全部题型。
• paper 模式：试卷文本格式。

适用于需要批量将 Excel 题库导入考试酷的场景。
